security: Keep configured Android chain balancing and source hooks. Native priority/capacity policy uses donor while affinity uses execution task. Native current/migrate-disabled exclusions and DL deboost replenishment remain. Restore active-mask restriction on NULL-context RT candidates; protect blocked owner sampling against remote PROXY_WAKING updates. No LTS safety behavior is intentionally weakened by these two adaptations.
lifetime: find_exec_ctx holds source rq lock and per-task blocked_lock while sampling typed owner. Both rq locks remain held through chain migration; owner sampling now also holds blocked_lock, released before callbacks. Tasks accepted for continued traversal are queued on the locked source rq; a pointer to a remote owner is checked and traversal stops. Preemption-disabled rq-lock regions protect task allocations under native RCU task release, but this does not freeze remote owner state. Queue/rq/queue barriers and subsequent locked checks remain. Original kernel primitive lifetimes must still obey their waiters; this is not protection against arbitrary invalid lock pointers.
semantics_limits: NULL execution context is intentional for RT chains leaving rq; DL find/preempt callers reject it. Missing or self owner returns the last task, not a guaranteed runnable endpoint. Ternary pushability 1 permits chosen CPU, -1 allows a different CPU, 0 rejects migration. Retry paths may move a prefix then recover through proxy selection; no global progress, deadlocked-graph cycle detection, real-time latency, affinity race or starvation proof. The generic move helper uses set_task_cpu, including its wake_cpu update; do not confuse it with proxy_migrate_task, which explicitly preserves a wake preference. Normal return/wakeup CPU selection still applies affinity validation.
hooks: find_lowest_rq has initialized -1 output but trusts nonnegative vendor override; callback must handle NULL exec_ctx and valid active/allowed CPU selection. Native filtering is not enforced against arbitrary trusted callback policy. No exact SDK callback registration was established; generic vendor source compatibility retained conservatively.
validation: 32768 static four-CPU helper cases: port passes, prior implementation fails 2800. 160 chain-owner host cases: port passes, prior implementation has 24 invalid-primitive and 24 unprotected-read cases under the forced interleaving/protocol check. These are extracted-function models, not kernel concurrency or boot verification. Emulator build 127 covers active-mask correction; subsequent build is required for owner-lock correction.
